scope: Existing production boundary characterization; no new product semantics

contracts.name: Foundation event and entity records
contracts.encoding: JSON; timestamps RFC3339Nano for typed contract records
contracts.validation: Event/Resident Validate methods; identifiers and enum/status rules are contract-specific
contracts.unknown_fields: encoding/json ignores unknown struct fields; custom Message decoder accepts its supported timestamp forms
contracts.compatibility: Current V1 fixture round-trip is automated; synthetic internal/foundationv1 is excluded from production ownership

contracts.name: Bus IPC Message
contracts.encoding: JSON line over local Unix socket
contracts.version: message version string; V1 canonical contract fixture
contracts.validation: Message.Validate plus bus framing and authenticated envelope checks where configured
contracts.unknown_fields: Ignored by custom typed decoder; payload remains RawMessage
contracts.compatibility: Current fixture and custom timestamp forms have contract tests; full authenticated socket envelope matrix remains a gap

contracts.name: Vision Go to Python worker request
contracts.encoding: JSON line over local Unix socket
contracts.version: operation names; protocol hello advertises synora.vision.v1
contracts.validation: Python operation/request checks; hello version and response correlation are validated in Go
contracts.unknown_fields: Python dictionary access ignores additional keys; Go request uses encoding/json tags
contracts.compatibility: Shared request is byte-semantically compared with Go serializer and consumed by dry-run Python worker

contracts.name: Vision Python to Go worker response and event
contracts.encoding: JSON line over local Unix socket
contracts.validation: Python EventBuilder restricts event names; Go decoder checks object, request_id, and events shape
contracts.unknown_fields: Go models payload as map[string]any and preserves unknown event fields inside that payload; structurally valid unknown event names remain data at this boundary and are not mapped to commands
contracts.compatibility: Python event payload, including nested fields, survives typed Go decode and actual Unix socket exchange; missing/null/empty payload behavior, malformed shapes, duplicate JSON keys, and absence of an explicit payload byte bound are characterized

contracts.name: Vision evidence and segment records
contracts.version: vision-evidence/v1; segment schema version as declared by its record
contracts.validation: Typed Validate methods check schema, ranges, and enum values
contracts.unknown_fields: Unknown JSON fields ignored by encoding/json; unknown enum values are contract-validated
contracts.compatibility: Evidence and representative segment records are serializer/decode golden-tested; gap and continuity-reset payloads are emitted through the production segment publisher; decoder explicitly preserves allowlisted node_id before validation

contracts.name: Camera observation
contracts.encoding: JSON; RFC3339 timestamp; canonicalized capability strings
contracts.validation: Canonical trims/deduplicates/sorts strings; EnsureID provides stable identifier
contracts.compatibility: Canonical camera observation round-trip, Discovery producer envelope, and online/offline/recovery event sequence are exercised with synthetic identifiers

contracts.name: Cognitive snapshots and decisions
contracts.producer: Core cognitive runtime and V3 adapter
contracts.consumer: StateStore, Core APIs, and qualification harnesses
contracts.validation: Version-specific Normalize/Validate; V1/V2/V3 normalization clamps or defaults selected values
contracts.unknown_fields: encoding/json ignores unknown struct fields; unknown strings normalize or fail according to each version
contracts.compatibility: V1 embedded persistence snapshot is golden-tested; dedicated independent V2/V3 snapshot goldens remain a coverage gap

contracts.name: Universal Store state, WAL, journal, and outbox
contracts.consumer: Core restart/replay, history, and action dispatcher
contracts.encoding: state.json materialized JSON plus newline-delimited journal.jsonl WAL
contracts.validation: OpenUniversalStore rejects corrupt JSON and unsupported state schema; replays WAL and checks bounds
contracts.unknown_fields: encoding/json ignores extra fields; schema version is explicitly checked
contracts.compatibility: Actual production serializer output is byte-compared with goldens, then opened in temporary directory; replay and outbox behavior asserted; Core temporal behavior is fixed-clock tested for event-time snapshot timestamps, arrival-order history, event-ID duplicate keys, epoch/sequence preservation, and missing received_at behavior

contracts.name: Action requests and results
contracts.owner: pkg/contract and internal/automation; Core ActionRequest outbox adapter
contracts.consumer: Discovery action dispatcher and event subscribers
contracts.encoding: Versioned JSON contract and typed JSON outbox record
contracts.version: contract action V1; cognitive action request V1
contracts.validation: pkg/contract validators; outbox request IDs are stable and store forces dry_run on commit
contracts.unknown_fields: Unknown struct fields ignored; action/status strings are checked by owning validators
contracts.compatibility: Public V1 fixtures round-trip and persisted outbox record is replay-tested

contracts.name: Device capability strings
contracts.owner: internal/device validation, Discovery camera observations, Vision worker capability status, and abstract Automation action identifiers
contracts.consumer: Discovery capability gates and automation policy
contracts.encoding: JSON string values in device/runtime records
contracts.version: No standalone schema version; values are string identifiers
contracts.validation: Device configuration strings receive syntax/duplicate checks only; Vision runtime features report separate status; Automation action labels are not operation bindings
contracts.unknown_fields: Unknown capability values are generally preserved as strings and denied unless explicitly supported
contracts.compatibility: Source-backed identifier inventory is machine-readable; strings are preserved as labels; unsupported physical operations remain unimplemented or denied/dry-run

contracts.name: Discovery API request/response DTOs
contracts.producer: Web UI and API clients; resident service for gallery views
contracts.consumer: Discovery command/event boundary and web clients
contracts.encoding: HTTP JSON; endpoint version is /api/v1 where applicable
contracts.version: API V1 path or endpoint-specific unversioned resident gallery routes
contracts.validation: Handler-specific JSON parsing, request scope checks, and DTO contract rules
contracts.unknown_fields: encoding/json decoders are generally permissive unless handler opts into stricter decoding
contracts.compatibility: State, health, websocket/SSE event, and resident gallery status handlers have synthetic response goldens; incident data appears only as a state projection and no separate incident endpoint was found
